sources.title: Exact tagged repository question and frozen Batch 0033 source boundary
Point-to-infinite-line deterministic C++20 validation against independent general-form oracle

claims.text: The repository preserves a 2D point-to-line C++ task; line representation, API, numeric/precision, degenerate and line-versus-segment details are answer-side contracts.
Under the explicit infinite-line/two-point contract, the exact fenced C++ computes abs(cross(B-A,P-A))/|B-A| and rejects a degenerate zero-length direction.
The C++20 fixture passes five named geometry cases, degenerate rejection, endpoint-order invariance, non-negativity and 5,000 deterministic random cases against an independent general-form oracle.

validation.reported_stdout: PASS fixed=5 random=5000 degenerate=rejected order=invariant nonnegative=true

findings: The exact repository source preserves a two-dimensional point-to-line coding task and explicitly requests C++; it does not preserve the line representation, function signature, coordinate range, precision, degenerate-input behavior, language standard, or line-versus-segment contract.

The candidate keeps the two-distinct-points representation, infinite-line semantics, long double choice, C++20 validation and A==B rejection explicitly answer-side rather than presenting them as recovered source facts.
The displayed C++ fence is byte-for-byte identical to the compiled fixture and implements abs(cross(B-A,P-A))/|B-A| with a zero-length guard.
Five named geometry cases cover horizontal, vertical, diagonal, on-line and nontrivial sloped inputs; the fixture also verifies degenerate rejection, non-negativity and endpoint-order invariance.
A deterministic set of 5,000 random integer-coordinate cases matches an independently expressed general-form Ax+By+C distance oracle within a bounded floating-point tolerance.
The answer distinguishes infinite-line distance from segment distance, explains the cross-product area mechanism, gives O(1) time/space, and does not fabricate project experience.
No placeholder implementation, unrelated topic content, uncovered source variant, or material unsupported claim remains in this candidate.
